verdict.rationale: Loops documents lifecycle workflows for onboarding, activation, upgrade, trial, winback and re-engagement, triggered by product events. Workflows are built as graphs whose nodes can be added, branched, edited or deleted, and the founder mentions SaaS lifecycle templates. Delays and exit rules, both named in the story, are not evidenced, and branching is shown only through the code/API surface rather than a marketer-facing visual builder. Missing for 10: documented time delays/wait steps, exit or goal rules, an evidenced no-code visual workflow builder for marketers, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-step automations.
